headline: Breakthrough Blueprint, from entry to detail
overview: The Breakthrough Blueprint is a structured framework for tackling your most significant personal challenges. It guides you through identifying a breakthrough challenge, conducting a SWOT analysis to understand your strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats, and then assessing your readiness to commit. Once you've defined your breakthrough, you can log regular check-ins to track progress and momentum over time.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Breakthrough Blueprint — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface. You can see the option to define a new breakthrough challenge and an overview of the structured process ahead.
steps.screenshotAlt: Breakthrough Blueprint landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Define and articulate personal breakthrough challenges with guided prompts
SWOT analysis framework to map strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats
Readiness assessment to evaluate your commitment and preparation level
Regular check-in tracking to monitor progress and maintain momentum
tips: Be specific when defining your breakthrough challenge — vague goals are harder to make progress on
Use the SWOT analysis honestly; identifying weaknesses and threats is just as important as your strengths
